collection.title: Volkswagen Phaeton 2003 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Volkswagen Phaeton 2003 to 2016 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
